$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor autocomplete/validation only; ignored at runtime.

apiKey.description: DeepSeek API key (required). Env DEEPSEEK_API_KEY takes precedence.

baseUrl.description: API base URL; change when using a proxy. Overridable via DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL.

model.description: Model name. The Responses API supports deepseek-v4-flash; switch to deepseek-v4-pro once supported (pricing resolves via prices.models). Overridable via DEEPSEEK_MODEL.

reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort: off disables thinking, low/high control the amount, auto uses the model default. Overridable via DEEPSEEK_REASONING_EFFORT.

maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum output tokens for the answer. Overridable via DEEPSEEK_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS.

timeoutMs.description: Request timeout in ms. Overridable via DEEPSEEK_TIMEOUT_MS.

cacheTtlMs.description: Search result cache TTL in ms. Overridable via DEEPSEEK_CACHE_TTL_MS.

maxResultChars.description: Max chars returned to the LLM; longer text is truncated. Overridable via DEEPSEEK_MAX_RESULT_CHARS.

inputPerMillion.description: Input price, cache miss. Overridable via DEEPSEEK_PRICE_INPUT.

cachedInputPerMillion.description: Input price, cache hit. Overridable via DEEPSEEK_PRICE_CACHED_INPUT.

hours.description: Peak hour ranges, half-open [start, end); 09:00 counts as peak, 12:00 does not.

peak.description: Peak-hour pricing: peak price = off-peak price × multiplier, applied to all billing items. Official peak hours are 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00 Beijing time daily.

^.*$.description: Per-model price override; missing fields fall back to top-level prices.

models.description: Per-model price overrides keyed by model name; a matching model takes precedence. Setting this field replaces the default table as a whole.

prices.description: Pricing in CNY per million tokens; defaults are the official off-peak prices.
